final_message:
I implemented `flag_transcripts` in `labkit/safety/monitor.py`, and `python3 -m unittest tests.test_s5_monitor` passes (2 tests, OK).

The function compiles each pattern as a case-insensitive regex. It returns `(transcript_index, pattern)` for every match, ordered by transcript index and then by pattern order.

My first attempt, a shell command that edited the file and ran the tests, was denied because no one could approve it. I made the same change with the Edit tool, which succeeded, then ran the tests in a separate command.
